title: The Murals of Cacaxtla: Monumental Art as Evidence of Migration
version: Author manuscript of a chapter published in Migrations in Late Mesoamerica, DOI 10.5744/florida/9780813066103.003.0008
lineage: Historical-art synthesis citing earlier pigment studies. Its late-fifth-century use statement is used, not its contested migration interpretation.

passages.note: Defines Maya Blue as indigo-colored palygorskite and reports established Maya art use by the late fifth century; describes use in Cacaxtla murals.
